title: Keep the object and reference types separate
explanation: hinted, base and role refer to one HintedPracticeQuestion object. Assigning it to an interface or superclass reference changes neither the object nor its runtime class. The separate plain question is an OpenPracticeQuestion.

title: Dispatch the overridden instance method
explanation: present receives a PracticeQuestion, while base.ask is called through OpenPracticeQuestion. Both reach the same object's HintedPracticeQuestion.ask override. Its explicit super.ask call reuses the base validation and wording before appending the hint.

title: Select an overload before runtime dispatch
explanation: select(base) chooses the OpenPracticeQuestion parameter signature at compile time; select(hinted) chooses HintedPracticeQuestion. Inside either selected body, question.ask still invokes the hinted object's override. Runtime dispatch does not redo overload selection.

title: Contrast fields and static methods
explanation: For this same object, baseMembers resolves badge and category using its OpenPracticeQuestion parameter type. childMembers uses HintedPracticeQuestion. Fields and static methods are hidden, not overridden. The instance-qualified static calls are deliberate counterexamples; prefer class-qualified calls in application code.
